description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractFromApiJsonDeserializer' which provides a base implementation for deserializing JSON input into command objects within the Fineract project. It declares an abstract method 'commandFromApiJson' that subclasses must implement to handle specific JSON deserialization logic.

classes.name: AbstractFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: An abstract class that implements the 'FromApiJsonDeserializer' interface, providing a template for deserializing JSON into command objects in the Fineract codebase.

methods.name: commandFromApiJson
methods.description: An abstract method that takes a JSON string as input and returns a command object of type T, which must be implemented by subclasses to define specific deserialization logic.
